hero.title: Seabourn Pursuit Ship Guide
hero.subtitle: Ultra-Luxury Expedition Cruising in Antarctica, the Arctic & Remote Polar Frontiers
paragraphs: Seabourn Pursuit is a purpose-built luxury expedition ship created for travelers who want to explore some of the world's most remote destinations without giving up the comfort and sophistication of an ultra-luxury cruise.

The sister ship to Seabourn Venture, Pursuit combines expedition capabilities with Seabourn's all-suite accommodations, fine dining, personalized service and intimate atmosphere. Instead of choosing between an adventurous expedition and a luxurious vacation, travelers can experience both.

Pursuit is particularly well suited to Antarctica, the Arctic and other remote expedition destinations, where Zodiacs, kayaks, expedition specialists and specialized equipment help guests experience the destination beyond the ship.

This guide covers the Seabourn Pursuit ship experience, suites, dining, expedition activities, onboard amenities and primary itineraries to help you decide whether Pursuit is the right expedition ship for your trip.

editorialIntro.heading: What Is Seabourn Pursuit & Why Is It Different?
paragraphs: Seabourn Pursuit is a purpose-built luxury expedition ship designed to take guests to destinations that require specialized equipment and expedition capabilities.

The ship entered service in 2023 and was designed as a sister ship to Seabourn Venture. Rather than focusing primarily on established ports and traditional sightseeing, Pursuit is designed around exploration, wildlife, nature and remote destinations.

Guests can spend part of the day exploring by Zodiac or kayak and return to the ship for a luxury suite, fine dining and Seabourn's personalized service. This makes Pursuit particularly attractive to travelers who want adventure without giving up comfort.

destinationsSection.title: Seabourn Pursuit Destinations
destinationsSection.subtitle: Pursuit is designed for remote destinations and expedition-style itineraries across Antarctica, the Arctic, Greenland and remote coastal regions.

tabs.title: Antarctica
tabs.shortDesc: Penguin colonies, tidewater glaciers, and polar Zodiac exploration
tabs.description: Antarctica is one of the ship's most important destinations. The combination of expedition equipment and luxury accommodation makes Pursuit particularly attractive for travelers who want an elevated Antarctic experience. Highlights include frequent Zodiac shore landings, intimate penguin rookery encounters, whale watching, iceberg viewing, glacier scenery, expedition lectures, and guided polar kayaking.

tabs.title: The Arctic & Svalbard
tabs.shortDesc: Drifting pack ice, polar bears, walruses, and historic exploration routes
tabs.description: The Arctic provides a completely different expedition environment. Depending on the itinerary, guests may encounter Arctic wildlife like polar bears, walruses, and Arctic foxes, massive calving tidewater glaciers, Norwegian fjords, drifting sea ice, remote islands, bird nesting cliffs, and indigenous communities.

tabs.title: Greenland & Northern Europe
tabs.shortDesc: Ilulissat icefjords, Inuit heritage, and remote volcanic coastlines
tabs.description: Greenland offers a combination of spectacular scenery, remote communities and cultural experiences. An expedition itinerary allows guests to experience massive icebergs in Ilulissat Icefjord, towering coastal fjords, active glaciers, remote Inuit settlements, and quiet kayaking in sheltered fjords.

items.title: Sophisticated Yacht-Like Atmosphere
items.description: Although Pursuit is designed for adventure, the ship itself remains sophisticated and comfortable. The result is an environment that feels more like a luxury yacht than a traditional expedition vessel.
items.bestFor: Lounges, Observation areas, Restaurants, Bars, Spa facilities, Fitness facilities, Outdoor spaces, Expedition briefings, and Educational presentations.

items.title: Observation Spaces
items.description: Observation areas are particularly important on an expedition ship, since the destination can change continuously throughout the day. For many travelers, simply watching the landscape from the ship is an important part of the experience.
items.bestFor: Wildlife, Icebergs, Mountains, Glaciers, Remote settlements, Birds, and Dramatic coastlines.

items.title: Seabourn Pursuit Spa and Wellness
items.description: After an active expedition day, wellness facilities provide an opportunity to relax. This is another area where Pursuit differs from expedition ships that focus almost exclusively on exploration.
items.bestFor: Spa treatments, Fitness facilities, Relaxation, and Wellness activities.

faqs.question: What is Seabourn Pursuit?
faqs.answer: Seabourn Pursuit is a purpose-built luxury expedition ship designed for remote destinations, including Antarctica and Arctic regions.

faqs.question: How many guests are on Seabourn Pursuit?
faqs.answer: Seabourn Pursuit accommodates approximately 264 guests.

faqs.question: When did Seabourn Pursuit enter service?
faqs.answer: Seabourn Pursuit entered service in 2023.

faqs.question: Is Seabourn Pursuit an expedition ship?
faqs.answer: Yes. Seabourn Pursuit was specifically designed for expedition cruising and remote destinations.

faqs.question: Does Seabourn Pursuit have Zodiacs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pursuit carries 24 Zodiacs for expedition landings and exploration.

faqs.question: Does Seabourn Pursuit offer kayaking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Kayaking is available on applicable expedition voyages, subject to weather, safety and participation requirements.

faqs.question: Does Seabourn Pursuit go to Antarctica?
faqs.answer: Yes. Antarctica is one of Seabourn Pursuit's primary expedition destinations.

faqs.question: Does Seabourn Pursuit go to the Arctic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected voyages explore Arctic regions.

faqs.question: Does Seabourn Pursuit visit Greenland?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected itineraries include Greenland and its remote coastal landscapes.

faqs.question: Are Seabourn Pursuit suites all-suite accommodations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pursuit is an all-suite luxury expedition ship.

faqs.question: Do Seabourn Pursuit suites have balconies?
faqs.answer: Many Seabourn Pursuit suites have private verandas. Exact features depend on the suite category.

faqs.question: What suite categories are available on Seabourn Pursuit?
faqs.answer: Pursuit offers multiple suite categories that can include Veranda suites, Penthouse suites, Premium suites and larger top-tier accommodations.

faqs.question: Is dining included on Seabourn Pursuit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dining is included as part of the Seabourn all-inclusive cruise experience.

faqs.question: What restaurants are on Seabourn Pursuit?
faqs.answer: Dining options can include The Restaurant, The Colonnade, Earth & Ocean and in-suite dining. Specific offerings can vary.

faqs.question: Does Seabourn Pursuit have a spa?
faqs.answer: Yes. Seabourn Pursuit provides spa and wellness facilities for relaxation after expedition activities.

faqs.question: Is Seabourn Pursuit good for first-time expedition cruisers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pursuit can be an excellent introduction to expedition cruising for travelers who want to combine adventure with luxury accommodations and personalized service.

faqs.question: Is Seabourn Pursuit good for couples?
faqs.answer: Yes. The intimate ship, luxury suites, remote destinations and shared expedition experiences make Seabourn Pursuit well suited to couples.

faqs.question: Is Seabourn Pursuit suitable for families?
faqs.answer: It can work well for adventurous multigenerational families, although it is not a traditional family resort ship. Activity age requirements should be checked before booking.

faqs.question: Are wildlife sightings guaranteed on Seabourn Pursuit?
faqs.answer: No. Wildlife sightings depend on natural conditions and cannot be guaranteed.

faqs.question: What destinations does Seabourn Pursuit visit?
faqs.answer: Seabourn Pursuit is designed for remote expedition destinations and can visit Antarctica, Arctic regions, Greenland, Iceland, Northern Europe and other remote coastal destinations depending on the itinerary.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Seabourn Pursuit and Seabourn Venture?
faqs.answer: Seabourn Pursuit and Seabourn Venture are sister expedition ships with many similar characteristics, including approximately 264 guests, 24 Zodiacs, PC6 polar capability, all-suite accommodations and dedicated expedition teams. Itinerary and departure date are often more important than choosing between the two.

faqs.question: Is Seabourn Pursuit worth the money?
faqs.answer: For travelers who prioritize luxury expedition travel, remote destinations, wildlife and personalized service, Seabourn Pursuit can offer strong value. It is less appropriate for travelers seeking a traditional large-ship vacation.

finalVerdict.title: Is Seabourn Pursuit a Good Expedition Ship?
finalVerdict.subtitle: FINAL VERDICT
paragraphs: Seabourn Pursuit offers a compelling combination of genuine expedition capability and ultra-luxury cruising. Its purpose-built design, Zodiacs, expedition team, kayaking opportunities and polar capability make it capable of exploring remote environments.

But the ship's real appeal is what happens after the expedition activity. You return from a Zodiac landing to a private luxury suite. You finish a day of wildlife viewing with fine dining. You can spend the evening listening to an expedition presentation or relaxing in an elegant lounge. That balance is what makes Seabourn Pursuit different — it brings the comforts of luxury cruising to destinations where adventure is the main attraction.
finalVerdict.recommendation: Our recommendation: Choose Seabourn Pursuit if you want genuine expedition capability, all-suite luxury, fine dining and access to Antarctica, the Arctic and other remote destinations — without giving up the comforts of an ultra-luxury cruise.
